name: branding-a4-letterhead-templates-with-curved-header-in-dark-and-purple-gold
title: Curved-Header A4 Letterhead Templates
whatItIs: A stock-template search screen showing two A4 letterheads on grey: a white sheet with a black curved header holding a logo and a red curved line, contact details, body text, signature and a three-column footer with red icons, and a second sheet with a plum header and a gold wave line.
whatItMeans: A single curved header band with a contrasting accent line gives stationery a formal yet dynamic look and a clear place for the logo.
techniques: Curved header band holding the logo
Thin accent line following the curve
Contact details grouped in a three-column footer
Sheet shown on a grey ground with a soft shadow

vocabulary.definition: Stationery with a branded header and footer.
A coloured strip across the top of a page.
A thin coloured line adding emphasis to a shape.
